name: error
description: Statement, number, or citation is factually wrong

name: issue
description: Works, but degraded (UX, layout, accessibility, performance)

name: problem
description: Structural defect blocking a core goal such as reproducibility

name: concern
description: Legal, privacy, ethical, or scientific credibility risk

name: dilemma
description: Fix trades one good against another; requires owner decision

name: conflict
description: Two parts of the repository disagree with each other

name: gap
description: Something expected or required is missing

name: hole
description: Unguarded input, boundary condition, or error path

name: blindspot
description: Something reported as real/measured that had not been audited
